$comment: Recurring failures, diagnosed once. A red gate with no cause attached looks identical to every other red gate, so a human re-diagnoses it every time. Each entry records the root cause, the evidence, whether it blocks a PR, and the fix. See scripts/classify-failure.mjs and docs/agent/LOOP.md.

conditions.symptom: 7 browser E2E tests time out waiting for POST /v1/decisions/evaluate in the served admin console. Identical on re-run.
conditions.looks_like: environment limitation - 'the api-server isn't fully served in this sandbox'
conditions.actual_cause: artifacts/signalgrid-app/vite.config.ts proxies ONLY /api/*. The failing route is /v1/decisions/evaluate - a different prefix - so the browser POST reaches the Vite server, matches no proxy rule, and hangs until Playwright's timeout. Two things mask it: (a) Playwright's health gate is /api/healthz, a prefix that IS proxied, so the api-server reports healthy while /v1 is unreachable from the page; (b) API_PROXY_TARGET defaults to http://localhost:8080 while Playwright starts the api-server on PORTS.api, so even /api calls point at the wrong port unless the variable is exported.
conditions.reproduces: anywhere API_PROXY_TARGET is not overridden - not sandbox-specific. Passes on a Mac only when a dev api-server already happens to occupy :8080.
conditions.why_not_blocking: Pre-existing and unrelated to any change that does not touch the proxy, the v1 router, or the Playwright config. Verify by confirming the PR touches none of those three.
conditions.fix: Add '/v1': { target: apiProxyTarget, changeOrigin: true } to apiProxy in artifacts/signalgrid-app/vite.config.ts, and export API_PROXY_TARGET to PORTS.api in the admin webServer env in scripts/playwright.config.ts.

conditions.symptom: check:postman, verify:ledger-export and test:stress were registered in package.json but invoked by no lane and no workflow.
conditions.looks_like: a large orphan count - naive audits reported 67, then 28, both false
conditions.actual_cause: check-ci-preflight-sync.mjs guards only proof: gates. The check:, guard:, verify: and test: prefixes - 35 gates - had no coverage guard. Compounding it, gates are invoked two ways (pnpm run name, and node scripts/file as preflight does), so an audit matching one style reports orphans that do not exist.
conditions.reproduces: deterministic - any gate added under a non-proof prefix could stop running unnoticed
conditions.fix: scripts/check-gate-census.mjs covers every prefix and matches both invocation styles; register it in preflight and CI with a self-test.
